topics.inclusion_rule: Sentence or phrase recognition from silently articulated speech measured by body-worn or contact non-video sensors (EMG, inertial, strain, triboelectric, magnetic, EMA, ultrasound, active acoustic); the design compared is how a sentence is decoded: whole-sentence classification, HMM decoding, CTC, or attention sequence-to-sequence. Boundary: lip video, imagined speech, overt-only and synthesis-only studies are outside; a study counts under every decoder its full text names (upper bound, related-work mentions included); versions count once.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes ctc, hmm, attention_seq2seq, sentence_as_class, word_concat_synthesis
topics.metric: sentence or phrase accuracy / WER at the stated vocabulary and split

topics.inclusion_rule: The same 54-study population as M06/wearable-silent-sentence-decoding, classified by how sentence-level training data are obtained or enlarged: synthetic sentences concatenated from recorded word samples, additive noise, time masking or warping; a study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound); a study that names concatenation only to reject it is counted and read.
topics.metric: sentence accuracy on actually spoken sentences when trained on synthetic concatenations

topics.inclusion_rule: Silent-speech studies (any task) whose ledger or full text names wearable accelerometers, gyroscopes or IMUs on the face, jaw or neck; the design compared is the inertial quantity used (acceleration only, gyroscope or attitude angles) and whether sensor count, subsets or axes are compared. Boundary: body-conduction microphones and accelerometers used only as vibration pickups for voiced speech, EMA/magnetic tracking without inertial sensors, and hand or body gesture IMUs are outside when read; versions count once.
topics.pattern: (?s)\A(?=.*(accelerometer|gyroscope|inertial (sensor|measurement)|\bimus?\b|motion capture))(?=.*(silent_articulation|no_vocalization|silent(ly)? (speech|articulat)|mouthed|lip language|subvocal|silent speech interface)) plus full-text pattern
topics.metric: silent word or sentence accuracy against sensor count

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: word or command classification studies with a wearable non-acoustic face or neck sensor, classified by how test samples are separated from training samples (speaker-disjoint, session- or day-disjoint, random or per-class split).
